profileEvidence.author: C
profileEvidence.summary: Pinschers have distinct characters: the German and Miniature Pinscher tend to be lively, spirited and self-assured, while the Affenpinscher is alert, persistent and devoted. This family includes both watch dogs and companions. The German Pinscher has a rat-catching past, and the Affenpinscher was kept as a house dog in southern Germany.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: From spirited German and Miniature Pinschers to the devoted Affenpinscher, this family has varied companion and watch-dog roles.
